purpose: The few facts the Lab OS dashboard needs that are not machine-readable elsewhere in the repository: the status of each MASTER_CONTEXT section 37 step, the compute we have, and the key documents. Everything else in the dashboard is derived automatically from repository files by scripts/export_lab_state.py. Every entry here is cross-checked by tests/test_lab_state.py: step titles must equal MASTER_CONTEXT section 37, cited experiments/decisions must exist, a 'complete' step may only cite complete experiments and accepted decisions, and cited files must exist.

current_work.title: D-049 accepted (step-12 model 14 x 896, 190 M parameters); EXP-043 proposed (train it on one Kaggle T4); needs "approve EXP-043"
current_work.note: D-049 accepted 2026-10-03 ("approve D-049"). EXP-043 (proposed, end of EXPERIMENTS.md): a true one-pass sampler (5,437,162 windows of 512, 169,911 steps of 16,384 tokens; today's sampler draws random windows with replacement, see the correction note under EXP-042); a learning-rate check {2.5e-4, 5e-4, 1e-3} x 100 M tokens with a pre-registered rule; the main run across about 9 Kaggle sessions with sha256-checked checkpoints passed between alternating kernels via kernel_sources (NOT VERIFIED on the account); sanity gate: beat EXP-042 C3-s3 (0.7736) by > 0.0174; reported: secondary-fit prediction 0.683. About 85 GPU-h (NOT VERIFIED), cap 100, about 3 weeks, Rs 0. No code before "approve EXP-043".
